visual.name: advanVisConfidenceScope
visual.description: Joint cost and schedule confidence for Power BI. ConfidenceScope runs a Monte Carlo simulation of your activity network inside the report: three-point durations, fixed and time-dependent costs, and risk events from your risk register. It shows every simulated outcome as a cloud of finish dates and costs, the chance of meeting your target date and budget together (joint confidence), the date and budget to commit to at the confidence you choose, the cost contingency and schedule margin to hold, and the activities and risks that drive them. A licence is required (one-month free trial through Microsoft AppSource).

zh-TW.role_activity_desc: Required. Each activity's unique ID, as the predecessors refer to it.
zh-TW.role_name_desc: Optional. Shown in the drivers and tooltips. The ID is used where it is empty.
zh-TW.role_group_desc: Optional. WBS, area or trade. Activities in a group run long or short together (Format pane, Simulation).
zh-TW.role_predecessors_desc: Optional. IDs separated by commas or semicolons, with link type and lag as in Project or P6: 12FS+2d, 14SS, A1020.
zh-TW.role_risk_desc: Optional. A risk register: one row per activity and risk. A risk on several activities occurs on all of them together.
zh-TW.role_duration_desc: The most likely duration in days. Required unless Planned start and Planned finish are given.
zh-TW.role_optimistic_desc: Optional. The shortest likely duration. Without it: 10% shorter (Format pane, Missing estimates).
zh-TW.role_pessimistic_desc: Optional. The longest likely duration. Without it: 30% longer.
zh-TW.role_start_desc: Optional. With Planned finish it gives the duration. Activities with no predecessors wait for it.
zh-TW.role_finish_desc: Optional. With Planned start it gives the duration.
zh-TW.role_progress_desc: Optional. 0 to 1 or 0 to 100. Finished work drops out; work in progress carries on from the status date.
zh-TW.role_cost_desc: Optional. The activity's fixed cost: materials, subcontracts, lump sums.
zh-TW.role_rate_desc: Optional. Time-related cost (crews, plant, site overheads), multiplied by the simulated duration, so delay costs money.
zh-TW.role_actualCost_desc: Optional. Actual cost so far. It is added to every future.
zh-TW.role_riskProbability_desc: Optional. The chance the risk occurs, 0 to 1 or 0 to 100.
zh-TW.role_riskDays_desc: Optional. The days the risk adds to this activity when it occurs (most likely).
zh-TW.role_riskDaysLow_desc: Optional. Without it, the Format pane's risk impact range applies.
zh-TW.role_riskDaysHigh_desc: Optional. Without it, the Format pane's risk impact range applies.
zh-TW.role_riskCost_desc: Optional. The cost the risk adds to this activity when it occurs.
zh-TW.role_targetDate_desc: Optional. The contract or promised finish. It overrides the Format pane.
zh-TW.role_budget_desc: Optional. The approved budget, spend to date included. It overrides the Format pane.
zh-TW.role_statusDate_desc: Optional. The data date of the update. It overrides the Format pane.
